name: Aussie Dollar Token
oneLiner: AUDX is TAU Pty Ltd's centralized Australian dollar stablecoin, designed for 1:1 AUD redemption and backed by AUD cash and government-backed instruments.
collateral: Backed 1:1 by Australian-dollar cash and government-backed instruments such as Treasury Bills and Notes, held by TAU Pty Ltd trading as AUDX Token
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed mint and redemption path targeting 1 AUDX = 1 AUD through fully backed Australian-dollar reserves

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Possible retained: reviewed metadata indicates direct token, vault, issuer, pause, proxy, or admin-control uncertainty, but available registry sources do not prove an active holder-balance blacklist path.

mintAuthority.summary: AUDX is issued by TAU Pty Ltd (trading as AUDX Token); minting and 1:1 AUD redemption run through the issuer's centralized backend against AUD cash and government-backed instruments held in reserve.

controls.label: TAU Pty Ltd issuance backend
controls.evidence: Issuer-managed mint/redeem: TAU Pty Ltd creates AUDX supply against custodied AUD reserves targeting 1 AUDX = 1 AUD; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route is described.

controls.label: AUDX DEFAULT_ADMIN + MINTER_ROLE (Ethereum + Polygon)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295029, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xc9d8...) and hasRole(MINTER_ROLE=0x9f2df0..., 0xc9d8...) both returned true on the AUDX ERC1967 proxy (impl: AussieDollarToken). Same confirmed on Polygon at block 88323844. eth_getCode returns no bytecode → EOA. Confirmed via RoleGranted events in creation tx (0x8dfc8be2...): all roles (DEFAULT_ADMIN, PAUSER, MINTER, BLACKLISTER, SALVAGER, UPGRADER) granted to this deployer address. Two mint() calls executed from this address on Ethereum.

review.evidence: AUDX issuer materials describe a single-entity issuer-managed mint and redemption path against fully backed AUD reserves. Ethereum and Polygon chains confirmed: a single EOA (0xc9d8...3e28) holds DEFAULT_ADMIN + MINTER_ROLE + all other roles on the AussieDollarToken UUPS proxy — verified via hasRole at blocks 25295029/88323844. XDC uses same contract address as Ethereum.
unresolvedQuestions: Conflux (0x47a365e29697c700c75d58936b3d93a8a20a43c9) and XDC (0xd687...e00c same address) mint authority not directly confirmed via RPC; XDC has no public node in standard list.
